gena.definition:
The cheek; the feathered side of the under mandible of a bird.
 The part of the head to which the jaws of an insect are
   attached.

genalkaloids.translation: [化] 氧化生物碱类(氨基变为氨氧基的生物碱)

genalloy.translation: 格内洛依耐热高镍铬合金钢

genaponta.translation: 后颊桥(由延长的后颊合并而成)

genappe.definition:
n. A worsted yarn or cord of peculiar smoothness, used in the
   manufacture of braid, fringe, etc.
